analysis.text: In this lecture today we are going to introduce the fundamentals of biology. Biology is the scientific study of life. The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of living organisms in. Organelle is a specialized structure within a cell that performs a specific function. Another important concept is. Homeostasis, which is the maintenance of a stable internal condition. In an Organism Finally, metabolism refers to the sum of chemical reactions that transform energy and matter in an Organism.
